privacy.text: Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy describes how React Bits Pro ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website at pro.reactbits.dev, our documentation, our license authenticated registry, the Landing Builder, and related services (the "Service").
We are the data controller for the personal data described here. You can reach us at pro@reactbits.dev for any question about this policy or to exercise the rights in Section 6.
1. Information We Collect
1.1 Information You Provide
When you use our Service, you may provide us with:

items: Account Information: Email address when you create an account or sign in via Google OAuth or magic link.
Payment Information: When you purchase a license, payment is processed by Polar.sh. We do not store your credit card details.
License Information: Your license key, tier, and license status, so we can verify what you have access to.

Saved Items and Folders: If you save a component, block, App UI block, template, or Agent Kit item, we store which item you saved, which folders it belongs to, and any folder names you create against your email address so your organization follows you between devices.
Communication Data: Information you provide when contacting us for support.

privacy.text: 1.2 Registry and Download Activity

Our components, blocks, App UI blocks, templates, and Agent Kit content are delivered through a registry that requires a valid license key. Each request to that registry is recorded, including when the request is made on your behalf by a CLI, an editor, or an AI coding agent. We log:

items: The license key used and the email address associated with it.
Which item was requested, and the request path and time.
IP address, user agent, and the approximate location (country, region, and city) derived from that IP address. We do not use precise or device-level location data.

privacy.text: We use this to confirm your entitlement, to operate and debug the registry, to understand which items are used, and to detect license key sharing and other unauthorized access. This record is what allows us to enforce our License Agreement, and we consider it necessary to protect the Service against piracy.
1.3 Documentation Code Access
Source code shown in the documentation is available only to signed-in customers whose license covers it. When you view the code for an item, we record:

items: Your email address and license tier.
Which item you viewed, and the time.
IP address, user agent, approximate location (country and city), and the address of the page the request came from.

privacy.text: We use this to confirm your entitlement and to detect unauthorized redistribution of paid material, including sites that proxy our documentation to people without a license.
1.4 Reports From Unauthorized Copies of the Service

Third parties sometimes republish our documentation on their own domains without permission, usually behind their own paywall. Because those pages are served from our code, our software can detect that it is running somewhere other than our own website and send us a short report.

That report contains the address of the unauthorized site, the page being viewed, and the IP address, user agent and approximate location (country and city) of the request. It is limited to one report per site per browsing session.

If you reached such a site, you may never have visited our website at all. We are telling you about this here because we still consider it your personal data. We use it only to identify and stop unauthorized copies of the Service, we do not use it to build any profile of you, and we do not attempt to identify you personally from it. You can ask us to delete it using the contact details in section 12.
1.5 Information Collected Automatically
When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:

items: Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent, and interactions with the Service via Vercel Analytics.
Device Information: Browser type, operating system, and device identifiers.
Log Data: IP address, access times, and referring URLs.

privacy.text: 1.6 Affiliate Referral Data

If you arrive through an affiliate link, Affonso detects the affiliate parameter and creates a privacy-limited referral identifier. Before consent is given where consent is required, no affiliate cookie is set and Affonso does not collect personal data. It may add an affonso_id identifier to the URL and record a minimal entry without IP address, browser, or location data. We preserve that identifier on internal links while your choice is pending so the referral is not lost as you move between pages.

Once affiliate tracking is permitted, Affonso may process the referral identifier, IP address, browser and device details, approximate location, URLs and referrers, and purchase, subscription, renewal, refund, or chargeback information needed to attribute a sale and calculate commission. Polar receives the referral identifier with checkout and reports eligible conversion information to Affonso.
1.7 Information Stored on Your Device
Some information is kept in your browser's local storage and is never sent to us:

Your recent searches in the documentation search dialog.

1.8 What We Do Not Collect
We do not collect the contents of your codebase, the projects you build with the Product, or anything an AI agent produces for you. We do not receive or store payment card details.

We do apply automated limits to protect the Service: if a single license key or network address makes an unusually large number of requests in a short period, further requests are temporarily refused, and a key used across an unusual number of addresses or countries is flagged for a person to review. Temporary limits lift by themselves. No account is ever suspended automatically: a human reviews the record first, and you can contest any decision using the contact details in section 12.
2. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected information for the following purposes:

items: To provide and maintain access to your purchased license
To authenticate your account and verify license ownership
To send transactional emails (purchase confirmations, magic links via Supabase)
To send occasional product updates and announcements (you can unsubscribe anytime)
To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
To improve our Service and develop new features
To detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized access
To verify entitlement to registry content and to detect license key sharing, resale, or other breaches of our License Agreement
To keep your saved items and folders available across your devices
To attribute eligible purchases and renewals to affiliate partners, calculate commissions, and administer the affiliate program
To meet our accounting, tax, and other legal obligations

privacy.text: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we rely on the following legal bases under the GDPR:

items: Performance of a contract: to give you access to what you purchased, to authenticate you, to verify your license, and to provide support.

Legitimate interests: to secure the Service, to detect and prevent license key sharing and piracy, to understand how the Service is used, and to improve it. We balance these against your interests, and limit registry logs to what is needed for that purpose.
Legal obligation: to keep purchase and tax records for the period required by law.

Consent: for optional product announcements, and for affiliate tracking where consent is required. You can withdraw consent at any time by unsubscribing, using the affiliate control in Section 7, or contacting us. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.

privacy.text: 4. Third-Party Services
We use trusted third-party services to operate our business. These services may have access to your personal information only to perform specific tasks on our behalf:
Supabase
Authentication, database, and file storage. Stores your account, license record, saved items, registry usage logs, and downloadable template files.
Polar.sh
Payment processing and license key issuance. Handles payment transactions securely and passes eligible conversion events to our affiliate provider when a referral is attached to the checkout.
Affonso

Affiliate referral tracking and program administration. Processes referral identifiers, attributed clicks and conversions, commission records, and the related technical data described in Section 1.6 on our behalf. See Affonso's privacy policy.
Vercel
Hosting and analytics. Provides website hosting and aggregate, cookieless usage analytics.
Google OAuth
Authentication. Allows you to sign in with your Google account. We receive only your email address.

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information, and we do not share it with third parties for their own marketing. We may disclose information where required by law, or where necessary to establish, exercise, or defend a legal claim, including enforcement of our License Agreement.
5. Data Retention
We keep personal data only for as long as we need it:

items: Account and license records: for as long as your license is valid. Because lifetime licenses do not expire, we retain those records indefinitely so that access continues to work. For annual subscriptions, we retain the record while the subscription is active and for a reasonable period afterwards so it can be renewed or restored.
Registry usage logs: up to 24 months, after which they are deleted or aggregated so they no longer identify you.
Documentation code access logs: up to 30 days. These exist to spot unauthorized redistribution as it happens, so they are not useful once stale.
Reports from unauthorized copies of the Service: up to 24 months, or longer where we need them as evidence in an ongoing copyright or enforcement matter.
License sharing flags: until the matter is reviewed and closed, and up to 24 months afterwards.
Saved items and folders: until you remove them or delete your account.
Support correspondence: up to 24 months after the matter is closed.

Affiliate referral and commission records: for as long as needed to administer and audit the affiliate program, including renewals, refunds, chargebacks, and payout disputes. Affonso retains referral analytics for the duration of our service relationship and deletes data under its retention procedures and applicable legal obligations when it is no longer required.
Purchase and invoice records: for the period required by applicable tax and accounting law, typically ten years.

privacy.text: You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us. Deleting your account ends registry access, and we may need to retain a minimal record of the purchase to meet the legal obligations above.
6. Your Rights
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate personal data.
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data.
Restriction: Ask us to limit how we use your data while a question about it is resolved.
Objection: Object to processing we carry out on the basis of legitimate interests, including our registry usage logging.
Withdraw consent: Withdraw any consent you have given, at any time.
Opt-out: Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time.
Portability: Request a portable copy of your data.

privacy.text: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below. We will respond within one month. We do not charge for this, and we will not treat you differently for asking.

If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom and believe we have not handled your data properly, you have the right to complain to your local data protection supervisory authority. In Romania this is the National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP). We would appreciate the chance to address your concern first.
7. Cookies and Local Storage
We use essential cookies to maintain your session and authentication state. These are required for signing in and cannot be turned off without breaking access to your account.
We also use Vercel Analytics to understand how visitors use our website. It reports in aggregate and does not use cookies to identify you across sites.

If you reach our site through one of our affiliate partners, our affiliate provider, Affonso, can store a first-party affonso_referral cookie recording the referral, so that the partner can be credited if you later purchase. It expires after 30 days, is only set for an affiliate referral, and is not used to profile you or track you across other websites. If you are in the EEA or the United Kingdom, or if we cannot determine your region, we ask for permission before setting it or enabling personal-data collection. Separately, we use your browser's local storage for the preferences, drafts, and affiliate consent choice described in Section 1.7. The stored choice stays on your device; accepting it enables the Affonso processing described above.

You can withdraw affiliate consent at any time. Doing so removes the referral cookie from this browser and prevents the referral identifier from being sent with future checkouts. It does not affect processing that occurred before withdrawal.
You can disable affiliate tracking and remove its referral cookie from this browser at any time.
8. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All data is transmitted over HTTPS, and sensitive information is encrypted at rest. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
If a breach affecting your personal data occurs and is likely to result in a risk to your rights, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority and, where required, you, without undue delay.
9. International Transfers

Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. Our service providers, including Supabase, Vercel, Polar.sh, Google, and their subprocessors, may store data in the United States or other jurisdictions. Affonso states that its affiliate-tracking infrastructure is hosted in Frankfurt, Germany. Where data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we rely on the safeguards the relevant provider has in place, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an applicable adequacy decision.
10. Children's Privacy

Our Service is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date, and where the change materially affects how we use your data, by email. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

alternatives.text: What makes React Bits Pro the strongest pick

items: Five pillars in one library. Creative components, page blocks, templates, app UI, and an Agent Kit. Most libraries give you components or blocks or templates. React Bits Pro ships all five across its tier system.

App UI you can theme in one move. All 300 app UI blocks read the same accent, base, font and radius variables, so a single change restyles the whole product surface instead of the block you happened to install. Every block also ships in two styles, Default and Sorbet, so the whole product's look switches in one click.
Two styling variants per component. Tailwind and vanilla CSS. No other library in this space ships both.
CLI-driven installs. Via the shadcn registry protocol. A single command lands the source in your repo.

An Agent Kit for AI-driven builds. Design skills, page prompts, and recipes that teach an AI agent to produce good-looking pages, plus a Starter-tier integration skill so Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Bolt.new, Lovable, and Replit install correctly on the first try.
One-time payment, lifetime updates. No subscription. No seat fees. Unlimited commercial projects.

alternatives.text: Compared to other animated component libraries

items: Magic UI has no vanilla-CSS variant, and its templates are a separate purchase (Magic UI Pro). See the full Magic UI comparison.
Aceternity UI uses copy-paste distribution (no CLI), Tailwind-only, and splits components and templates across tiers. See the full Aceternity UI comparison.
Cult UI covers a smaller catalog without app UI blocks or full templates.
Free reactbits.dev covers individual components for side projects. Pro adds blocks, app UI, templates, the Agent Kit, and a commercial license. See the full comparison.

alternatives.text: shadcn/ui, Radix UI, and React Aria are headless behaviour libraries. They give you buttons, dialogs, dropdowns, and form primitives, and they focus on accessible behaviour rather than animation, marketing UI, or full sections. React Bits Pro is the animated marketing and app UI layer that sits on top, and most customers run both. See the full shadcn/ui comparison.

HeroUI (formerly NextUI), Mantine, Chakra UI, and Park UI are opinionated full design systems distributed as npm packages. They typically add a runtime dependency and a consistent house style. React Bits Pro takes a different approach: source-code delivery, no runtime lock-in, and animated marketing UI designed to feel custom.

Tailwind UI / Tailwind Plus, Vercel templates, cruip.com, and various Once UI starters compete on templates alone. React Bits Pro is both a template library and a component library. The templates are built from the same components and blocks you can mix and match in your own designs, so you're not locked into a single template author's aesthetic.

Framer, Webflow, and Wix Studio are a different category of tool: hosted no-code builders. If you're a React developer shipping a real product, you want code you control, deploy anywhere, and integrate with the rest of your stack. That's what React Bits Pro delivers.
We keep this page accurate. If a library's scope or license changes, email pro@reactbits.dev and we'll update it.
Buy once. Own the source. Lifetime updates.

affiliate.text: How it works

items: Apply. Applications are reviewed by hand. Tell us where you would promote it, which takes one line.
Get your link. You receive a unique tracking link and a dashboard showing clicks, conversions and earnings in real time.
Share it. In a video description, a newsletter, a blog post, a tutorial or a comparison table, wherever it fits honestly.
Get paid. Commission is confirmed once the order clears, then paid out through our affiliate platform.

affiliate.text: Attribution

We use a 30-day, last-click attribution window. If someone follows your link and buys within 30 days, the sale is yours, even if they leave and come back later through a search result. Developer tools are rarely an impulse purchase, so the window matters more here than the click does.

Visitors in the EEA and the UK are asked for consent before we store the tracking cookie, because the law requires it. Anyone who declines cannot be attributed. That is a small share of traffic, and it is the only case where a real referral may go uncredited.

If your audience includes people in the EEA or the UK, tell them that they need to accept the affiliate cookie for their purchase to credit you. Keep that explanation honest: accepting is optional and is never required to browse the library or complete a purchase.
Program rules
Short version: promote it honestly and you will never run into any of these.

items: No self-referrals. Buying through your own link does not earn commission, and neither does routing your own team or clients through it to discount their purchase.
No paid search on our brand terms. Please do not bid on "React Bits", "React Bits Pro" or close variants. That charges us for traffic which was already ours.
No coupon, deal or cashback sites, and no browser extensions that inject affiliate links.
No misrepresentation. Do not advertise the paid library as free, invent discounts that do not exist, or imply you speak for React Bits.
No spam. No unsolicited email, no comment or DM blasts, no scraped lists.
Refunds and chargebacks reverse the commission. All sales are final under our license terms, so this is rare.

affiliate.text: We may decline an application or end a partnership, normally for one of the reasons above.
Questions
Do I need to own React Bits Pro to promote it?

No. It does help, since owning it lets you show real work rather than describe it, and demos convert better than descriptions. But it is not a requirement and it plays no part in whether an application is accepted.
Can I promote the free React Bits instead?

Link to it as much as you like, but the free library at reactbits.dev costs nothing, so there is nothing to commission. It still makes a good top of funnel: send people there, then point out that the paid library exists.
What happens if the buyer uses a discount code?
Commission is calculated on the amount actually paid, so a discounted sale pays a smaller commission rather than none.
Does an annual subscription pay again when it renews?
Yes. Every renewal pays you 30% again, for as long as that customer keeps their subscription active. A referred subscriber is an income stream rather than a one-off payment.
Can I use your screenshots and recordings?
Yes. Anything on this site or on reactbits.dev can be used to promote the library, component recordings included. The one thing you may not do is redistribute the source code itself.
How do I get paid?
Through our affiliate platform, once the order has cleared. Pending and confirmed earnings are shown separately in your dashboard.
